intro_html: This one takes the sandwich you love and drops the roll, so you keep all the flavor and skip the carb crash. It packs 41 grams of protein per bowl and lands around $4.73 a serving (at everyday cost), which is a steal for something that tastes like a diner splurge. One skillet, 14 servings, no hoagie required.
cost_closing_html: About $4.73 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Each of the 14 bowls gives you 41 grams of protein and about 579 calories.
upsell_html: Make a batch Sunday and you have got lunch handled all week without touching a drive-thru. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Buy the 93/7 ground beef in the 5 lb value pack instead of the little trays. The per-pound price drops and it is the biggest line on your bill.
Grab whole mushrooms and slice them yourself. Pre-sliced costs more and goes slimy faster.
A carton of beef broth stretches across several batches, so one carton covers this recipe and then some.
make_it: Brown the ground beef in a big skillet, breaking it up as it cooks, then drain off any grease.
Add the sliced mushrooms, green peppers, and onion and cook until they soften, about 6 to 8 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and a splash of beef broth, then let it simmer a couple minutes to pull it all together.
Kill the heat and lay the provolone over the top so it melts into the beef.
Spoon it over cooked white rice and stir once so every bite gets some cheese.

head.description: A high-protein American meal prep. Fourteen servings at about 579 calories and 41 grams of protein for roughly $4.73 each (at everyday cost).
